message:
The `/api/v1/users/me` endpoint now includes the user's bracket name when they have a bracket assigned, making it easier to display bracket information without requiring additional API calls.

## Changes Made

Modified the `UserSchema` in `CTFd/schemas/users.py` to include a `@post_dump` method that adds the bracket name to the response for the "self" view when a user has a bracket assigned.

## API Response Changes

**Before:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "user",
    "bracket_id": 2,
    "email": "user@example.com",
    ...
  }
}
```

**After:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "user",
    "bracket_id": 2,
    "bracket": "Advanced Players",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    ...
  }
}
```

## Implementation Details

- Only applies to the "self" view (when users query their own data via `/api/v1/users/me`)
- Bracket name is only included when the user has a `bracket_id` assigned
- Uses efficient lookup based on the existing `bracket_id` field
- Gracefully handles edge cases like deleted brackets
- No impact on other API endpoints or views

## Testing

Added comprehensive tests in `tests/api/v1/users/test_bracket_name.py` that verify:
- Users with brackets receive the bracket name in the response
- Users without brackets do not receive the bracket field
- Edge cases are handled correctly
- No regression in existing functionality

Fixes #2843.
